description: Version pins live in deploy/environment/versions.env and reach the helmfile through requiredEnv, so Renovate's built-in helmfile manager cannot see them - it reads chart versions written literally in the helmfile. The customManagers block reads the '# renovate:' comment above each variable instead.
Validate changes with: npx --yes --package renovate -- renovate-config-validator (run from the repo root, or it is treated as global config).

customManagers.description: Chart and image pins in deploy/environment/versions.env. The optional prefix before the last colon lets a variable hold a full image reference (registry/name:tag) as well as a bare version.

packageRules.description: One PR a week for the infrastructure pins rather than one each. They are validated together by scripts/validate-helm.sh and proven together by a rebuild.
The Debezium Platform chart moves fast and changes behaviour between pre-releases. It gets its own PR, never grouped, and is merged only after a deployment has been tried by hand.
A PostgreSQL major version is a data migration for an existing CloudNativePG cluster, not a tag change. Minor and patch bumps only.

The OTel operator CHART version and the collector IMAGE tag pinned in deploy/values/dmp/ocp.yaml.gotmpl are separate number lines. Renovate only sees the chart, so flag the PR as needing a look at the collector image.
GitHub Actions in one PR, pinned to commit digests by the helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests preset above.
